*** ADVISOR TOOL: AUDITED FOR THE FIRST TIME EVER. 2 FINDINGS. ***
  Found by chasing the Sonnet 5.5 line "the advisor tool rejects Opus 4.8, Opus 4.7 and
  Sonnet 5 as advisors". Type string is advisor_20260301 — dated MARCH 2026, so this has
  been live and uncovered for ~6 months. Literal facts in cache/anthropic_advisor_tool.txt.
  Headlines:
  * Advisor receives the executor's FULL TRANSCRIPT: system prompt + tool definitions +
    all prior turns + all tool results + in-flight executor text. server_tool_use.input is
    ALWAYS EMPTY — the app cannot see or control what was sent.
  * max_uses DEFAULT IS UNLIMITED.
  * On Sonnet 5.5 / Fable 5.1 / Mythos 5.1 / Opus 5.5 / Opus 5 / Fable 5 / Mythos 5 the
    result is advisor_redacted_result with encrypted_content, and those executors pair ONLY
    with encrypted-returning advisors => THE ADVICE TEXT IS UNREADABLE BY THE CUSTOMER.
  * SECOND SHAPE on Claude Managed Agents: roster entry {"type":"advisor","model":...},
    advice arrives as THREAD EVENTS, not advisor_tool_result blocks. Block-type detectors
    miss this path.
  * Beta on Claude API + Claude Platform on AWS. NOT Bedrock / Google Cloud / Foundry.
  UNMINED advisor doc sections (NEXT BACKLOG ITEM): Multi-turn conversations (Resuming a
  paused turn; Mid-conversation nudge for under-calling executors), Advisor prompt caching
  (executor-side vs advisor-side), Combining with other tools.

=== METHOD NOTE WORTH KEEPING ===
Today's two HIGH findings came from following a cross-reference inside a release note
("the advisor tool rejects...") to a doc page that no feed ever announced. The feed told us
a model shipped; the CROSS-REFERENCE told us a whole tool existed. Chase the nouns in
release notes that the monitor has never seen before — grep reports/ for each one.
